In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code
 of Criminal Procedure in connection with Rejinagar P.S. Case
 No.219 of 2023 dated 02.08.2023 under Sections
 363/365/376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the
 Pocso Act.

In the matter of : Hasanurzamal Mondal @ Hasan Mondal.
 ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Arnab Chatterjee,
 Mr. Anisur Rahaman.
 ...for the Petitioner.
 Mr. Atif Ahmed Siddiqui.
 ...for the State.
 1.
Petitioner is in custody for 63 days.
He contends he is not the principal accused.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. Service upon the victim is not complete.
4. Officer-in-charge, Rejinagar Police Station shall intimate the victim with regard to pendency of proceeding and her right to participate therein.
She shall also be intimated of the next date of hearing.
6. In view of the extent of complicity of the petitioner in the crime, we are inclined to grant interim bail to him.

7. Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner viz., Hasanurzamal Mondal @ Hasan Mondal shall be released on interim bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,

8. Interim bail shall continue till 6th December, 2023 or until further order whichever is earlier.
